title: Mayflower: Native SwiftUI Academic Planner for Colby College on macOS, iPhone and iPad — Degree Audit, Workday Course Schedules and Moodle — Robert Zhou
description:
Mayflower is an unofficial native SwiftUI academic planner for Colby College students on Mac, iPhone and iPad. After the student signs in to Colby themselves, it reads their own Workday courses, degree progress and Moodle data, then helps plan schedules and track degree requirements across Colby's programs. It never registers for classes on the student's behalf.

This repository hosts the Mayflower website, privacy policy, terms and support pages (https://bobzhou-source.github.io/mayflower/). Mayflower is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Colby College.

Author: Robert Zhou, Colby College. Portfolio: robertzhou.dev. Project write-up: https://robertzhou.dev/work/. Source: github.com/bobzhou-source/mayflower.
